oppose.translationZh: 一位法官已否决了这一决定。

ought.sentenceEn: Weeks after completing the expedition, Hayden collected his team's observations into an extensive report aimed at convincing senators and representatives, along with colleagues at government agencies like the Department of the Interior, that Yellowstone ought to be preserved.
ought.translationZh: 探险结束数周后，海登将团队的观察结果整理成一份详尽报告，旨在说服参议员、众议员以及内政部等政府机构的同僚们，黄石地区应当得到保护。

ought.sentenceEn: Cooper and her colleagues argue that the success of the crown for Hull, where it brought in £220m of investment and an avalanche of arts, ought not to be confined to cities.
ought.translationZh: 库珀及其同僚认为，赫尔市获得这一头衔所取得的成功——该称号为赫尔带来了2.2亿英镑的投资和大量艺术活动——不应仅限于城市。
ought.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第3句

ought.sentenceEn: Researchers admit that their study does not answer the question of how much businesses ought to spend on CSR.
ought.translationZh: 研究人员承认，他们的研究并未回答企业究竟应该在企业社会责任上投入多少资金的问题。
ought.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第1句

ought.sentenceEn: Charles ought to know that as English history shows, it is kings, not republicans, who are the monarchy's worst enemies.
ought.translationZh: 查尔斯应当知道，英国历史已然表明，君主制最大的敌人并非共和党人，而是君主自身。
ought.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第7段，第4句

ought.sentenceEn: Rosenberg argues convincingly that public-health advocates ought to take a page from advertisers, so skilled at applying peer pressure.
ought.translationZh: 罗森伯格令人信服地指出，公共卫生倡导者应当向广告商学习，后者深谙如何运用同辈压力。
ought.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第4句

ought.sentenceEn: The goals of researchers ought to be realistic.
ought.translationZh: 研究人员的目标应当切合实际。

obesity.sentenceEn: Worse, when policies like the national obesity strategy are scrapped, taxpayers are left with the heavy price tag of treating the illnesses, like diabetes, that result.
obesity.translationZh: 更糟糕的是，当国家肥胖战略这类政策被取消后，纳税人最终要为治疗由此引发的糖尿病等疾病支付高昂费用。
obesity.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第4句

obesity.sentenceEn: Obesity has risen among adults and children.
obesity.translationZh: 成人和儿童的肥胖率都有所上升。
obesity.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第9句

obesity.sentenceEn: Obesity is probably less a matter of weight than body fat.
obesity.translationZh: 肥胖问题或许与其说是体重问题，不如说是体脂问题。
obesity.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第2句

obesity.sentenceEn: Stereotypes associated with obesity include laziness, lack of will power, and lower prospects for success.
obesity.translationZh: 与肥胖相关的刻板印象包括懒惰、缺乏意志力以及较低的成功前景。
obesity.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第3句

obesity.sentenceEn: Today we have a(n) tendency to label obesity as a disgrace.
obesity.translationZh: 如今，我们往往将肥胖视为一种耻辱。
obesity.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第1句

obesity.sentenceEn: Of even greater concern is the fact that obesity turns out to be very difficult to define.
obesity.translationZh: 更令人担忧的是，肥胖其实很难定义。
obesity.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第1句

operator.sentenceEn: Ferrovie dello Stato Italiane, the publicly controlled group that owns train operator Trenitalia and the national train network RFI, said 23 percent of all high-speed trains it operated were late in 2023.
operator.translationZh: 意大利国家铁路公司（Ferrovie dello Stato Italiane）表示，其运营的所有高铁中，2023 年的晚点率达 23%。该公司是一家控股铁路运营商 Trenitalia 和国家铁路网 RFI 的国有企业。
operator.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第2句

operator.sentenceEn: RFI, the network operator , is the single largest European recovery fund beneficiary with planned investments of €24bn by 2026.
operator.translationZh: 作为网络运营商，意大利铁路网公司（RFI）是欧洲复苏基金最大的单一受益方，计划到 2026 年投资 240 亿欧元。
operator.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第2句

operator.sentenceEn: This narrowing of the regulatory scope was a victory for builders, mining operators and other commercial interests often at odds with environmental rules.
operator.translationZh: 监管范围的这种缩小对建筑商、采矿运营商以及其他常常与环境法规存在冲突的商业利益集团而言是一场胜利。
operator.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第3句

operator.sentenceEn: As an effective Washington operator , Hayden sensed that he could capitalize on the expedition's stunning visuals.
operator.translationZh: 作为一名在华盛顿颇具影响力的活动家，海登意识到他可以利用这次探险中令人惊叹的视觉资料。

operator.sentenceEn: It is all very well train operators trumpeting the improvements they are making to the network, but passengers should be able to expect a basic level of service for the substantial sums they are now paying to travel.
operator.translationZh: 铁路运营商大肆宣扬他们对铁路网所做的改进，这固然不错，但乘客支付了如此高昂的票价，理应享受到基本水平的服务。
operator.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第2句

operator.sentenceEn: How can the train operators possibly justify yet another increase to rail passenger fares?
operator.translationZh: 铁路运营商又一次提高客运票价，这究竟如何说得过去？
operator.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第1句

opposition.sentenceEn: About eight million square metres of plastic grass is sold each year but opposition has now spread to the highest gardening circles.
opposition.translationZh: 每年约有800万平方米的塑料草坪售出，但反对之声现已蔓延至园艺界的最高层。
opposition.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第2句

opposition.sentenceEn: Mayor José Luis Martinez-Almeida made opposition to the zone a centrepiece of his election campaign, despite its success in improving air quality.
opposition.translationZh: 市长何塞·路易斯·马丁内斯-阿尔梅达将反对该区域作为其竞选活动的核心议题，尽管该区域在改善空气质量方面已取得成功。
opposition.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第3句

opposition.sentenceEn: And if Sadiq Khan wins and extends it to the North and South Circular roads in 2021 as he intends, it is sure to spark intense opposition from the far larger number of motorists who will then be affected.
opposition.translationZh: 而如果萨迪克·汗胜选并按其计划在2021年将该区域扩展至北环路和南环路，必将引发受影响的更广泛驾车群体的强烈反对。
opposition.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第5句

opposition.sentenceEn: Opposition to telescopes on Mauna Kea is nothing new.
opposition.translationZh: 反对在莫纳克亚山上建造望远镜并非新鲜事。
opposition.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第1句

opposition.sentenceEn: The opposition claims primary school pupils doing at least two hours of sport a week have nearly halved.
opposition.translationZh: 反对党称，每周进行至少两小时体育活动的小学生人数几乎减少了一半。
opposition.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第8句

opposition.sentenceEn: Washington, who had begun to believe that all men were created equal after observing the bravery of the black soldiers during the Revolutionary War, overcame the strong opposition of his relatives to grant his slaves their freedom in his will.
opposition.translationZh: 华盛顿在独立战争期间目睹了黑人士兵的英勇表现后，开始相信人人生而平等。他不顾亲属的强烈反对，在遗嘱中赋予了他的奴隶们自由。
opposition.paperLabel: 考研英语 2008 英语（未分卷）
opposition.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第2句

ordinary.sentenceEn: There is no good reason that these artifacts should be beyond the ordinary reach of the educational objectives or inspiration of the generations to which they were left.
ordinary.translationZh: 没有充分理由让这些文物脱离其本应传承给的后代子孙的教育目标或灵感启迪的寻常可达范围。
ordinary.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第3句

ordinary.sentenceEn: Personal grievance procedures were designed to guard the jobs of ordinary workers from "unjustified dismissals".
ordinary.translationZh: 个人申诉程序旨在保护普通工人的工作免遭“不当解雇”。
ordinary.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第1句

ordinary.sentenceEn: Consequently—and paradoxically—laws introduced to protect the jobs of ordinary workers may be placing those jobs at risk.
ordinary.translationZh: 因此，矛盾的是，那些旨在保护普通劳动者工作的法律，反而可能将这些工作置于危险之中。
ordinary.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第1句

ordinary.sentenceEn: Although mental health is the cure-all for living our lives, it is perfectly ordinary as you will see that it has been there to direct you through all your difficult decisions.
ordinary.translationZh: 尽管心理健康是我们生活中的万能良药，但它其实非常平凡——你会发现，它一直在那里指引你做出所有艰难的决定。
ordinary.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第1句

ordinary.sentenceEn: It is only the Queen who has preserved the monarchy's reputation with her rather ordinary (if well-heeled) granny style.
ordinary.translationZh: 唯有女王以其相当亲民（尽管也颇为富足）的祖母形象，维护了君主制的声誉。
ordinary.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第7段，第1句

ordinary.sentenceEn: But the idea that the journalist must understand the law more profoundly than an ordinary citizen rests on an understanding of the established conventions and special responsibilities of the news media.
ordinary.translationZh: 但是，认为新闻记者必须比普通公民更深刻地理解法律，这一观点基于对新闻媒体既有的行业惯例和特殊责任的理解。
ordinary.paperLabel: 考研英语 2007 英语（未分卷）
ordinary.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第1句

overlook.sentenceEn: Yet still our libraries are often overlooked and underappreciated.
overlook.translationZh: 然而，我们的图书馆往往仍被忽视，且其价值未得到充分认可。
overlook.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第4句

overlook.sentenceEn: The Gutenberg printing press transformed civilisation not by changing the nature of writing but by changing its cost—and it would have achieved little without a parallel collapse in the price of surfaces to write on, thanks to an often- overlooked technology called paper.
overlook.translationZh: 古腾堡印刷机改变了文明，并非通过改变书写的本质，而是通过改变其成本——如果没有另一种常被忽视的技术（即纸张）导致书写载体价格的同步暴跌，印刷机也难以取得多大成就。
overlook.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第7段，第1句

overlook.sentenceEn: "This isn't something you can do overnight," says Keri L. Denay, MD, lead author of a recent American College of Sports Medicine advisory that encourages Americans to not overlook the benefits of activity during the pandemic.
overlook.translationZh: 医学博士凯里·L·德奈表示：“这不是一蹴而就的事情。”她是美国运动医学会近期发布的一份指南的主要作者，该指南鼓励美国人在疫情期间不要忽视运动的益处。
overlook.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第4句

overlook.sentenceEn: When education becomes one-size-fits-all, it risks overlooking a nation's diversity of gifts.
overlook.translationZh: 当教育变成一刀切的模式时，就可能忽视一个国家人民天赋的多样性。
overlook.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第8段，第2句

overlook.sentenceEn: Today, widespread social pressure to immediately go to college in conjunction with increasingly high expectations in a fast-moving world often causes students to completely overlook the possibility of taking a gap year.
overlook.translationZh: 如今，要求学生立即上大学的普遍社会压力，加之在这个瞬息万变的世界中日益增高的期望，往往导致学生们完全忽视了间隔年的可能性。
overlook.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第1句

overlook.sentenceEn: Its negative effects on businesses are often overlooked .
overlook.translationZh: 其对企业的负面影响往往被忽视。

obviously.sentenceEn: Second, growth obviously affected the absolute size both of systems and individual institutions.
obviously.translationZh: 其次，高等教育的发展明显影响了整个体系和各个院校的绝对规模。
obviously.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第3句

obviously.sentenceEn: While he obviously had an abundance of natural talent, the final, polished work that he gave to the world was the result of years of practicing, re-writing and reading.
obviously.translationZh: 虽然他显然天赋异禀，但呈现在世人面前的那些精良作品，是他多年练习、重写与阅读的成果。
obviously.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第6句

obviously.sentenceEn: Why do people read negative Internet comments and do other things that will obviously be painful?
obviously.translationZh: 为什么人们会阅读负面的网络评论，以及做其他明显会带来痛苦的事情呢？
obviously.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第1句

obviously.sentenceEn: The growth of the use of English as the world's primary language for international communication has obviously been continuing for several decades.
obviously.translationZh: 作为全球主要国际交流语言，英语的使用显然已持续增长数十年。
obviously.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第1句

obviously.sentenceEn: On first hearing, this was the socially concerned chancellor, trying to change lives for the better, complete with "reforms" to an obviously indulgent system that demands too little effort from the newly unemployed to find work, and subsidises laziness.
obviously.translationZh: 乍一听，这似乎是一位心系社会的财政大臣，试图改善人们的生活，并对一个明显纵容的体系进行"改革"——该体系对新失业者找工作的努力要求过低，实则助长了懒惰。
obviously.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第6句

obviously.sentenceEn: Social psychologists have amassed oceans of research into what they call the "above average effect", or "illusory superiority", and shown that, for example, 70% of us rate ourselves as above average in leadership, 93% in driving and 85% at getting on well with others – all obviously statistical impossibilities.
obviously.translationZh: 社会心理学家已积累了海量关于他们称之为“高于平均水平效应”或“虚幻优越感”的研究，并指出，例如，70%的人认为自己的领导力高于平均水平，93%的人认为自己的驾驶能力高于平均水平，85%的人认为自己与人相处的能力高于平均水平——这些在统计学上显然都是不可能的。
obviously.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第3句

organisation.sentenceEn: According to our research, 25% have decided to either outright ban AI or regulate its use within their organisations .
organisation.translationZh: 根据我们的研究，25%的受访者已决定在组织内彻底禁止使用人工智能，或对其使用进行规范。
organisation.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第6句

organisation.sentenceEn: It added: "We prefer to help people and organisations make the right choice rather than legislating on such matters. However, the use of artificial grass must comply with the legal and policy safeguards in place to protect biodiversity and ensure sustainable drainage, while measures such as the strengthened biodiversity duty should serve to encourage public authorities to consider sustainable alternatives."
organisation.translationZh: 政府补充道：“我们更倾向于帮助民众和机构做出正确选择，而非对此类事务进行立法。不过，人造草坪的使用必须遵守现行的法律和政策保障措施，以保护生物多样性并确保可持续排水，同时，像强化生物多样性义务这样的措施应有助于鼓励公共机构考虑可持续的替代方案。”
organisation.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第1句

organisation.sentenceEn: It is hard to get right, and requires a remarkable degree of vision, as well as cooperation between city authorities, the private sector, community groups and cultural organisations .
organisation.translationZh: 要做到恰到好处并非易事，这需要非凡的远见卓识，以及城市当局、私营部门、社区团体和文化组织之间的通力合作。
organisation.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第5句

organisation.sentenceEn: David Graddol concludes that monoglot English graduates face a bleak economic future as qualified multilingual youngsters from other countries are proving to have a competitive advantage over their British counterparts in global companies and organisations .
organisation.translationZh: 大卫·格拉多尔得出结论：只会说英语的英国毕业生面临着黯淡的经济前景，因为事实证明，在全球企业和机构中，其他国家具备资质的多语言年轻人比他们的英国同龄人更具竞争优势。
organisation.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第1句

organisation.sentenceEn: The anticipation of possible shifts in demand provided by this study is significant: It gives a basis to all organisations which seek to promote the learning and use of English, a basis for planning to meet the possibilities of what could be a very different operating environment.
organisation.translationZh: 这项研究对需求可能发生的变化所做的预测具有重要意义：它为所有致力于推广英语学习和使用的机构提供了一个基础，一个为应对可能截然不同的运营环境而制定规划的基础。
organisation.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第1句

organisation.sentenceEn: In today's world, it has become normal that well-paid executives should not be accountable for what happens in the organisations that they run.
organisation.translationZh: 在当今世界，拿着高薪的高管不必为其管理的机构内所发生的事情负责，这已成为常态。
organisation.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第1句

originate.sentenceEn: In the United States, the desire to provide the public with a general, nontechnical education in science originated as far back as the late 1800s.
originate.translationZh: 在美国，为大众提供非技术性科普教育的初衷最早可以追溯到 19 世纪晚期。
originate.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第1句

originate.sentenceEn: Soon after Sketches by Boz appeared, a publishing firm approached Dickens to write a story in monthly installments, as a backdrop for a series of woodcuts by the then-famous artist Robert Seymour, who had originated the idea for the story.
originate.translationZh: 《博兹特写集》问世后不久，一家出版公司便找到狄更斯，邀请他按月分期撰写一个故事，作为当时著名艺术家罗伯特·西摩系列木版画的背景内容——这个故事的创意正是西摩提出的。

originate.sentenceEn: The group in question is a particular people originated from central Europe.
originate.translationZh: 文中所指的这个群体是一个起源于中欧的特定民族。
originate.paperLabel: 考研英语 2008 英语（未分卷）
originate.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第3句

originate.sentenceEn: What the researchers found was at once both amazing and expected: the US National Aeronautics and Space Administration's Cosmic Background Explorer satellite—Cobe—had discovered landmark evidence that the universe did in fact begin with the primeval explosion that has become known as the Big Bang (the theory that the universe originated in an explosion from a single mass of energy).
originate.translationZh: 研究人员的发现既令人惊讶又在预料之中：美国国家航空航天局的宇宙背景探测卫星（COBE）已经发现了具有里程碑意义的证据，证实宇宙确实起源于一次原始爆炸，即我们现在所说的"大爆炸"（该理论认为宇宙源自单一能量团的爆炸）。
originate.paperLabel: 考研英语 1998 英语（未分卷）
originate.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第4句

originate.sentenceEn: For example, British anthropologists Grafton Elliot Smith and W. J. Perry incorrectly suggested, on the basis of inadequate information, that farming, pottery making, and metallurgy all originated in ancient Egypt and diffused throughout the world. In fact, all of these cultural developments occurred separately at different times in many parts of the world.
originate.translationZh: 例如，英国人类学家格拉夫顿·艾略特·史密斯和W.J.佩里基于不充分的资料错误地提出，农业、制陶术和冶金术都起源于古埃及，然后传播到世界各地。事实上，所有这些文化发展都是在世界不同地区于不同时期独立出现的。
originate.paperLabel: 考研英语 2009 英语（未分卷）

outdated.sentenceEn: The causes of the UK's current position are complex and range from outdated perceptions of productive forestry to the decimation of trees by grey squirrels.
outdated.translationZh: 英国当前局面的成因复杂多样，既包括对生产性林业的过时认知，也涉及灰松鼠对树木的大规模破坏。
outdated.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第3句

outdated.sentenceEn: She uses outdated research and decades-old examples to undermine the noble mission of organizations committed to connecting children to a world beyond their own.
outdated.translationZh: 她用过时的研究和几十年前的例子来诋毁那些致力于带领孩子们了解更广阔世界的组织所肩负的崇高使命。
outdated.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第8段，第2句

outdated.translationZh: 然而这种理解已经过时了。
outdated.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第3句

outdated.sentenceEn: Symbolic of national unity as they claim to be, their very history – and sometimes the way they behave today – embodies outdated and indefensible privileges and inequalities.
outdated.translationZh: 尽管君主们声称自己是国家统一的象征，但他们的历史——有时还有他们如今的行事方式——却体现着过时且站不住脚的特权与不平等。
outdated.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第2句

outdated.sentenceEn: To take advantage of this tool, some impoverished countries will have to get over their outdated anti-colonial prejudices with respect to foreign investment.
outdated.translationZh: 为了充分利用这一工具，一些贫困国家必须摒弃在外国投资问题上那些过时的反殖民偏见。
outdated.paperLabel: 考研英语 2001 英语（未分卷）
outdated.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第1句

owe.sentenceEn: Customers now routinely see menus of suggested default options—often well above 20% of what they owe .
owe.translationZh: 顾客现在经常会看到建议的默认选项菜单——通常远高于账单金额的20%。
owe.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第3句

owe.sentenceEn: Customers were generally responsible for paying the sales tax to the state themselves if they weren't charged it, but most didn't realize they owed it and few paid.
owe.translationZh: 如果商家没有向顾客收取销售税，顾客通常需要自行向州政府缴纳，但大多数人并未意识到自己有此义务，因此很少有人实际缴纳。
owe.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第2句

owe.sentenceEn: Its current leader, Ed Miliband, owes his position to votes from public-sector unions.
owe.translationZh: 该党现任领袖埃德·米利班德的职位要归功于公共部门工会的选票支持。
owe.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第8句

owe.sentenceEn: Owing to the remarkable development in mass-communications, people everywhere are feeling new wants and are being exposed to new customs and ideas, while governments are often forced to introduce still further innovations for the reasons given above.
owe.translationZh: 由于大众传播的显著发展，各地民众正产生新的需求，并接触到新的习俗和观念，而政府则往往迫于上述原因不得不推出更多创新举措。
owe.paperLabel: 考研英语 2000 英语（未分卷）
owe.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第1句

ownership.sentenceEn: There's also a knowledge gap that needs to be addressed — 40% of individuals surveyed are unsure about who retains ownership over the content produced by AI.
ownership.translationZh: 此外，还存在一个亟待解决的认知鸿沟——40% 的受访者不确定 AI 生成内容的归属权究竟属于谁。
ownership.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第3句

ownership.sentenceEn: The idea of involving children in a big decision is a great idea because it can help them feel a sense of control and ownership in what can be an overwhelming process, said Ryan Hooper, clinical psychologist in Chicago.
ownership.translationZh: 芝加哥临床心理学家瑞恩·胡珀表示：“让孩子参与重大决策是个很棒的想法，因为在这个可能令人不知所措的过程中，这能帮助他们建立掌控感和归属感。”
ownership.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第1句

ownership.sentenceEn: The other reason why costs are so high is the restrictive guild-like ownership structure of the business.
ownership.translationZh: 成本如此高昂的另一个原因是该行业限制性的行会式所有权结构。
ownership.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第1句

ownership.sentenceEn: Now, consider three indices of assimilation – language, home ownership and intermarriage.
ownership.translationZh: 现在，我们来看看同化的三个指标——语言、住房拥有率和异族通婚。
ownership.paperLabel: 考研英语 2006 英语（未分卷）
ownership.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第5句

ownership.sentenceEn: By 1996 foreign-born immigrants who had arrived before 1970 had a home ownership rate of 75.6 percent, higher than the 69.8 percent rate among native-born Americans.
ownership.translationZh: 到1996年，1970年前抵达美国的外国出生移民拥有住房的比例达到75.6%，高于本土出生美国人69.8%的比例。
ownership.paperLabel: 考研英语 2006 英语（未分卷）
ownership.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第5句

ownership.sentenceEn: Thus, in his view, diverse aspects of culture, such as the structure of families, forms of marriage, categories of kinship, ownership of property, forms of government, technology, and systems of food production, all changed as societies evolved.
ownership.translationZh: 因此，在他看来，文化的各个方面，如家庭结构、婚姻形式、亲属类别、财产所有权、政府形式、技术和食物生产体系，都随着社会的演变而发生变化。
ownership.paperLabel: 考研英语 2009 英语（未分卷）

obscure.sentenceEn: Oman rated Scovell's significance highly, but at the same time, the general nature of his History meant that he could not analyze carefully what this obscure officer may or may not have contributed to that great struggle between nations or indeed tell us anything much about the man himself.
obscure.translationZh: 奥曼高度评价斯科维尔的重要性，但同时，由于其《半岛战争史》的通史性质，他无法详细分析这位名不见经传的军官对那场国家间的伟大斗争可能做出了哪些贡献，也无法确切地告诉我们关于斯科维尔本人的更多信息。
obscure.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第4句

obscure.sentenceEn: At the same time, Dickens, who had a reporter's eye for transcribing the life around him, especially anything comic or odd, submitted short sketches to obscure magazines.
obscure.translationZh: 与此同时，狄更斯以记者特有的敏锐观察记录着身边的生活，尤其善于捕捉那些滑稽或奇特的事物，并向一些名不见经传的杂志投稿短篇随笔。

obscure.sentenceEn: Yet its report may well set back reform by obscuring the depth and breadth of the challenge that Congress asked it to illuminate.
obscure.translationZh: 然而，其报告掩盖了国会要求其阐明的挑战的深度和广度，很可能会阻碍改革的进程。
obscure.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第2句

obscure.sentenceEn: That might seem rather an obscure point, but it sets the tone for an exhibition that contains a lot of black-and-white photographs and relatively few natural objects.
obscure.translationZh: 这一点可能有些晦涩难懂，但它为整场展览奠定了基调——展览中包含大量黑白照片，而实物展品则相对较少。
obscure.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第1句

obscure.sentenceEn: The legal issues in the case are obscure : whereas the Supreme Court has ruled that states do have some regulatory authority over nuclear power, legal scholars say that Vermont case will offer a precedent-setting test of how far those powers extend.
obscure.translationZh: 此案涉及的法律问题晦涩复杂：尽管最高法院已裁定各州确实对核能拥有一定的监管权，但法律学者表示，佛蒙特州这起案件将成为一个开创先例的测试，检验这些权力究竟能延伸到何种程度。
obscure.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第2句

obscure.sentenceEn: Factors such as the place and period in which we are reading, our gender, ethnicity, age and social class will encourage us towards certain interpretations but at the same time obscure or even close off others.
obscure.translationZh: 诸如阅读的地点和时期、我们的性别、种族、年龄和社会阶层等因素，会促使我们倾向于某些解读，同时却掩盖甚至排除了其他可能的理解方式。

occupy.sentenceEn: As well as making access both in and out of buildings easier for people, the difference in the way many of these doors open helps reduce the total area occupied by them.
occupy.translationZh: 除了为人们进出建筑物提供便利外，这些门的多种开启方式还有助于减少其总体占地面积。
occupy.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第1句

occupy.sentenceEn: Another set of participants had to count backward from 1,000 by nines as they watched the clips, occupying their conscious working memory.
occupy.translationZh: 另一组参与者在观看视频片段时，需要从1000开始倒数，每次减9，这占用了他们的有意识工作记忆。
occupy.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第4句

occupy.sentenceEn: Just 25 per cent of the country's land is suitable for crop-growing, most of which is already occupied by arable fields.
occupy.translationZh: 该国仅有25%的土地适合农作物种植，其中大部分已被耕地占用。
occupy.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第3句

occupy.sentenceEn: Completed in 1875, the State Department's south wing was the first to be occupied , with its elegant four-story library (completed in 1876), Diplomatic Reception Room, and Secretary's office decorated with carved wood, Oriental rugs, and stenciled wall patterns.
occupy.translationZh: 国务院南翼于1875年竣工，是首个投入使用的部分，其内设有典雅的四层图书馆（1876年完工）、外交接待室和部长办公室，这些空间均采用木雕、东方地毯和模板墙面图案进行装饰。

occupy.sentenceEn: But just some 22,000 birds remain today, occupying about 16% of the species' historic range.
occupy.translationZh: 但如今仅存约22,000只，其栖息地面积仅为该物种历史分布范围的16%左右。
occupy.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第2句

occupy.sentenceEn: On the overturned provisions the majority held Congress had deliberately " occupied the field" and Arizona had thus intruded on the federal's privileged powers.
occupy.translationZh: 对于被推翻的条款，多数法官认为国会已刻意'占据该领域'，因此亚利桑那州侵犯了联邦的特权。
occupy.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第2句

optimism.sentenceEn: "While there is some optimism that emerging countermeasures and best practices may see piracy begin to plateau by 2027, there is no consensus among stakeholders as to when it may begin to decline," says analyst Steve Hawley.
optimism.translationZh: 分析师史蒂夫·霍利表示：“尽管有人乐观地认为，通过采取新的应对措施和最佳实践，盗版活动可能在2027年前后开始趋于稳定，但利益相关者对于盗版何时可能开始减少尚未达成共识。”
optimism.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第2句

optimism.sentenceEn: It's a form of innate or unlearned optimism .
optimism.translationZh: 这是一种与生俱来的、无需学习的乐观态度。
optimism.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第3句

optimism.sentenceEn: The researchers wanted to know if the optimism and inclination for risk-taking that come with happiness would change the way companies invested.
optimism.translationZh: 研究人员想知道，伴随幸福感而来的乐观精神和冒险倾向是否会改变企业的投资方式。
optimism.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第1句

optimism.sentenceEn: Most people would define optimism as being endlessly happy, with a glass that's perpetually half full.
optimism.translationZh: 大多数人会将乐观定义为永远快乐，总觉得杯子里的水永远是半满的。
optimism.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第1句

optimism.sentenceEn: "Healthy optimism means being in touch with reality," says Tal Ben-Shahar, a Harvard professor.
optimism.translationZh: 哈佛大学教授塔尔·本-沙哈尔说：“健康的乐观意味着与现实接轨。”
optimism.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第3句

optimism.sentenceEn: History and news become confused, and one's impressions tend to be a mixture of skepticism and optimism .
optimism.translationZh: 历史与新闻变得混淆不清，人们的印象往往是怀疑与乐观交织的复杂感受。
optimism.paperLabel: 考研英语 2005 英语（未分卷）
optimism.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第2句

organize.sentenceEn: Yet researchers can take some comfort in the fact that there are a multitude of librarians devoted to discovering, organizing , and preserving digital information for researchers current and future.
organize.translationZh: 然而，研究人员可以稍感慰藉的是，有众多图书管理员致力于为当下及未来的研究人员发现、整理和保存数字信息。
organize.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第2句

organize.sentenceEn: But the skills they learn – how to think logically through a problem and organize the results – apply to any coding language, said Deborah Seehorn, an education consultant for the state of North Carolina.
organize.translationZh: 但他们所学的技能——如何通过逻辑思考解决问题并整理结果——适用于任何编程语言，北卡罗来纳州教育顾问黛博拉·西霍恩说道。
organize.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第3句

organize.sentenceEn: Mies's signature phrase means that less decoration, properly organized , has more impact than a lot.
organize.translationZh: 密斯的标志性格言意味着，经过恰当布局的简约装饰比繁复装饰更具冲击力。
organize.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第1句

organize.sentenceEn: A variety of activities should be organized so that participants can remain active as long as they want and then go on to something else without feeling guilty and without letting the other participants down.
organize.translationZh: 应当组织丰富多彩的活动，让参与者可以随心所欲地保持活跃状态，之后转做其他事情时也不会感到内疚，也不会让其他参与者失望。
organize.paperLabel: 考研英语 2003 英语（未分卷）
organize.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第2句

organize.sentenceEn: Companies with low accident rates plan their safety programs, work hard to organize them, and continue working to keep them alive and active.
organize.translationZh: 事故率低的公司会规划其安全项目，努力组织实施，并持续致力于保持项目的活力与有效性。
organize.paperLabel: 考研英语 1999 英语（未分卷）
organize.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第2句

organize.sentenceEn: New ways of organizing workplaces may help to increase productivity.
organize.translationZh: 新型的工作场所组织方式可能有助于提高生产力。
organize.paperLabel: 考研英语 1998 英语（未分卷）

outline.sentenceEn: To help improve HAPs, urban planner Rajashree Kotharkar's team is working on a model plan that outlines best practices and could be adapted to local conditions.
outline.translationZh: 为了帮助改进健康行动计划（HAPs），城市规划师拉贾什里·科萨尔卡尔的团队正在制定一个模型计划，其中概述了最佳实践，并可根据当地情况进行调整。
outline.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第1句

outline.sentenceEn: Your senior colleague outlines a project timeline you believe is unrealistic.
outline.translationZh: 你的资深同事制定了你认为不切实际的项目时间表。
outline.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第2句

outline.sentenceEn: But the article is actually quite optimistic, as it outlines a potential solution to this problem, suggesting that an approach (which involves a one-hour, next-to-no-cost program) can close 63 percent of the achievement gap (measured by such factors as grades) between first-generation and other students.
outline.translationZh: 但这篇文章实际上相当乐观，因为它提出了一个可能的解决方案，表明有一种干预方法（包括一个时长一小时、几乎零成本的项目）能够缩小第一代大学生与其他学生之间63%的成绩差距（以成绩等因素衡量）。
outline.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第1句

outline.sentenceEn: Your outline should smoothly conduct you from one point to the next, but do not permit it to railroad you.
outline.translationZh: 你的提纲应当引导你从一个观点自然过渡到下一个观点，但不要让它束缚你的思路。
outline.paperLabel: 考研英语 2008 英语（未分卷）
outline.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第2句

outline.sentenceEn: It makes no difference how you write, just so you do. Now that you have developed a topic into a tentative thesis, you can assemble your notes and begin to flesh out whatever outline you have made.
outline.translationZh: 你采用何种方式写作并不重要，重要的是动手去写。既然你已经将一个主题发展成初步的论文观点，就可以整理笔记，开始充实你所拟定的任何提纲了。
outline.paperLabel: 考研英语 2008 英语（未分卷）
